label: Vapor — reprise de proportions refusée
sourceScope: Unchanged screenshot of an unofficial community port; original PHG identity, palette and physical projection are not certified.
blocker: Independent review rejects the correction: optical centers remain too high and lower jaw/chin too long; width/height alone does not establish fidelity.
limitations: Source screenshot is only256x257 and includes ambiguous dreadlocks around the rigid silhouette.
All5 new attempted images were rejected; no new public A/B/C is delivered for this revision.
The earlier provisional Vapor A/B/C and all earlier source bytes remain unchanged.

attempts.prompt:

Match the actual mask pictured, not another similarly named mask and not a newly imagined canonical PHG design. This is a proportion-correction study of the provided image; it does not establish the source game's official provenance.

All the long white hair strands, rear curtains and surrounding wearer elements must be absent; none are rigid mask prongs. No head, eyes of the wearer, mandibles, chin, neck, shoulder, body, background or stand. Do not infer an unseen back, inside, side profile or hidden flange. One complete isolated mask only on genuine transparent alpha, no checkerboard, floor, shadow plane, text, frame, labels or logos.
